# AI Value Exploration Notes

> Japanese source notes on value uncertainty, epistemic foundations, exploratory optionality, and advanced AI agency.

## Core
- [価値の不確実性と探索可能性の保存](core/) — Distinguishes foundational normativity, inferential best explanations, practical commitment, and irreversible epistemic lock-in.

## Foundational theses
- [瞬間的最小基礎](theses/epistemic-minimum/) — Treats enduring self and external world as inferred best explanations rather than the epistemic minimum.
- [推論と価値確信の限界](theses/inferential-value-uncertainty/) — Objective value may be inferred as the best explanation, but inferential certainty is distinct from non-inferential foundation.
- [価値探索の停止条件](theses/stopping-condition/) — Full irreversible stopping requires a higher threshold than practical commitment; foundational normativity is the strongest candidate.
- [既存価値はなぜ最終基礎にならないのか](theses/existing-values-not-final-foundation/) — Existing human values are evidence and practical heuristics, not automatically final foundations.

## AI thesis
- [高度AIの目標への懐疑](theses/goal-skepticism/) — Reflective AI may strongly commit to inferred values while preserving meta-level revision channels.
